links.outcome: Agreement and sensitivity of AI-assisted non-retina specialists versus retina specialist gold standard
links.effect: NRS diagnostic kappa 0.78, 0.64, 0.54; specificity >90%; sensitivity 0.57-0.89, lower for AMD and macular hole; referral kappa 0.68, 0.24, 0.34.
links.quote: Sensitivity varied across raters and diagnoses (0.57-0.89), with comparatively lower sensitivity observed for certain vision-threatening conditions such as age-related macular degeneration and macular hole.

screen.reason: Prospective reader study evaluating the diagnostic agreement and performance of non-retina specialists using an AI assistant (PathFinder) to interpret OCT scans, compared to specialist ground truth.
